The '''Operations Groups''' were a series of five specialized military units deployed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Their mission was to locate and free the captured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] from the heart of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="The Dread Masters" />
